The sentence also contradicts the same note's correct statement that correct:false cells are absent from the ranked list.

If a ranked-list/validity-rule disagreement example is needed, only the kinetic-claude/kinetic-0715[1m] 03 suspect cell (peak_fraction 0.0622, present in the 03 ranked list) qualifies; the muse 04 bug cell is absent from the 04 ranked list because correct is false.

findings.evidence: The claim 'One unlimited agent session per cell' is asserted but no supplied source establishes a session policy: SPEC.md (SOURCE 3) states none, leaderboard.json shows only per-cell run_ids and elapsed_seconds, and the site excerpt says nothing.
